deep_dive.summary: GammaLabTechnologies/harmonist is gaining traction with 1,280 stars. Portable AI agent orchestration with mechanical protocol enforcement. 186 agents, zero runtime dependencies.. This represents a significant trend in Python tooling for production systems. FDEs should understand whether this is a flash-in-the-pan or a genuine shift in how teams build AI systems.
deep_dive.fde_takeaway: Evaluate GammaLabTechnologies/harmonist for client relevance. If it solves a real problem, early expertise = premium positioning. If not, you save clients from chasing hype.
